how_to_use: REELS ONLY. The 9 AM and 7:30 PM reels are the ABAP course from pipeline/syllabus.json (see README 'Course reels'); these topic lists are for the 1:00 PM free-topic reel only (12-18 s). Take the first unused topic: first the 'reel' list, then 'post', 'carousel_concept', 'carousel_interview' (unused = not in state.json history). Prefer topics the course has not just covered. When lists run out, invent new ones (tips, bugs, interview questions, performance, T-codes from syllabus section 16). Never repeat a topic in history. Even day-of-month: plug ABAP Code Vault in the caption; odd day-of-month: interview angle + ABAP Interview Pack plug. Sunday 1 PM is the FAQ reel: use the 'faq' list (see README '1 PM slot').
